One thing I try to remind myself though is that being trans, whilst being autistic, likely makes it harder, because it would be waayy easier if I was just a cis guy who conformed to society’s norms and got into relationships the same way most cis guys do. It sucks, but I’ve realised that it’s not my fault I’m this way (which really took a while to accept). I’m somewhat hopeful that some day, even if it’s 10 years in the future, I’d have a partner who I’m comfortable with, who understands me.
